description:
SocialSeal helps brands and marketers win new customers through social video. Use its social media data and research tools to understand your market and plan content.
Search videos on TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Douyin and Xiaohongshu (RedNote). Explore audience demand and keyword opportunities by market and language to inform social SEO. Check your brand's search visibility and compare competitors, with share-of-voice tracking over time.
Find relevant creators for influencer marketing. Evaluate Instagram profiles using recent posts and engagement metrics, or analyse a video link for hooks and creative ideas. Develop content strategies and creator briefs grounded in your research. Monitor supported accounts and searches, then export findings for reports.
Start with a brand, a research question, a video URL or a Tiktok/Instagram handle.

defaultPrompt: Check whether my brand appears in social search. Show the relevant topics, competitors and supporting sources.
Show the five latest eligible posts for a public creator, with source links, available views and engagement.
Retrieve my saved report and export its supporting evidence.
